content_zh:
“哈哈，你看这事闹得，好了好了，先别哭了，来来来，擦擦眼泪，工作上以后要遇到的困难多了——”
在世界上的任何地方，年轻可爱的女孩子都是有点特权的，一个四十多岁的大姐被说哭，同事也许无动于衷，不过，刚进单位的小姑娘被刁难得站在当地就哭起来，老领导肯定是要上去劝的，马医生最热心，揽过胡悦连声哄，刘主任也被逗笑了，一边看着师医生一边劝，“——病人比这个不讲理的时候有的是，难道你次次都哭啊？”
他不这么讲还好，一开口，新人全被吓住了，还想上来帮着劝劝，混点印象分的，这会儿只好尴尬束手，各自看老板脸色行事，戴韶华不讲话，跟了刘主任的卢阳雨硬着头皮站出来，“是啊，胡悦，别哭啦，师主任肯定不是这个意思。”
“就是这个意思。”
胡悦这一哭，把年轻的师主任哭到人民对立面去了，他也不急不躁的，双手环胸，长腿交叠，斜靠着办公桌还在玩手机，头也不抬飘出一句，直接把卢阳雨噎得话都说不出来，扎着手站在那里，申永峰倒是蛮有香火情，把他拉回去，马医生说，“哎哟，师主任，不要这样欺负小年轻嘛。”
“实话啊。”
长得这么帅，业绩那么好，对客户又那么不客气，上来就说新人丑，师主任难免给人目下无尘的狂傲印象，可和同辈说话的时候，他的脸又翻得很快，手机一放，语气一下就正常又和蔼，“马医生你看她，左右脸不对称，额头过饱满、颊脂垫这么厚，说好听点，娃娃脸，说难听点就是大饼脸……”
师主任好像很看重个人空间，没有靠近，从白大褂上口袋掏出一根激光笔，在胡悦脸上指指点点，“看皮肤，很白，嗯，以为这就能和医美比了？其实也就是仗着年轻，很少在护肤品上投入吧，满满都是隐患，看她颊部的雀斑，乍看无伤大雅，刘主任你是皮肤科的，拉去照一下仪器，保证可以看到五年以后那层皮上长满日晒班。”
进来做住院医的，自然都有丰富的实习经历，师主任的语气按就诊讲不算太过火，很多有绝活的医生就这个强势态度，几个新人听得一愣一愣，都有人下意识拿小本本出来记录了。胡悦这下是真的尴尬，要继续哭，没这个氛围，感觉玻璃心有点过，但她姿态已经做出来了，不继续哭，站在这里被说更尴尬：刚才被说一声丑都哭了，这下被当成教材指指点点，这还不得哭崩啊？要是不哭，你刚才哭什么？
师医生这是第一次正眼看胡悦，他瞥她一眼，眼神里带着点凉凉的笑，像是一眼就看到她心底：这种初出茅庐的小姑娘，想和他玩心眼，是不是还嫩了点？
“她不是颌面修复的吗？想去隔壁修复中心，主任应该会很欢迎啊。到我们小组那就不行，人家客户过来都是带着信念来的，你得让她们相信，只要功夫深，铁杵磨成针，大力出奇迹嘛，有钱就能变得更美。”他说，比比胡悦的脸，“像她这种长相，还怎么站在我旁边？”
这都什么歪理？马医生摇头直笑，“按你这么说，我也不要做面部结构了？”
“好了好了，”张主任也看不下去了，“马上八点，都赶快先去诊室吧。”
别人的热闹，大家不看白不看，刘主任这样的还会下场搅和，不过，现在快到八点，门诊就要叫号，看戏总比不上打卡重要，大家都带着包身工走了，马医生心好，拉着默默流泪的胡悦出去，“师主任一直就这样，不是针对你。他就不爱带住院医，安排几个怼出去几个，都这样——那几个后来是走了，拿到主治就去外面莆田系，不然马上都能介绍给你认识。”
她看看戴韶华再看看胡悦，也有点无奈，但仍决定，“你就先跟我吧，没事，师主任不要，我巴不得多个人。不哭不哭了啊，我是四号诊室，你先去洗把脸吧，一会直接过来就行了。”
想想，又加一句，“还有，师主任的话，你别往心里去，他自己那么帅，美女也看得太多，对人要求当然高，咱们又不是明星，够用不就行了吗？”
话是这么说，但到底也没否认师霁的评语……没有正面驳这么一个‘丑’字……

content_en:
"Haha, look at what happened. Okay, okay, don't cry now. Come on, wipe your tears. You will encounter many difficulties at work in the future -"
Anywhere in the world, young and cute girls are somewhat privileged. When a eldest sister in her forties is told to cry, her colleagues may be indifferent. However, when a young girl who has just entered the unit starts to cry when being teased, the old leader must go up and persuade her. Dr. Ma is the most enthusiastic.
It's okay if he didn't say that. As soon as he opened his mouth, the newcomers were all frightened. They wanted to come up to help persuade and gain some impression. At this moment, they had to restrain themselves in embarrassment and each acted according to the boss's face. Dai Shaohua didn't speak. Lu Yangyu, who was following Director Liu, stood up bravely and said, "Yes, Hu Yue, don't cry. The division director definitely didn't mean this."
"That's what it means."
Hu Yue's cry made the young division director cry to the people. He was not impatient, leaning on his desk with his hands folded across his chest and long legs folded, still playing with his mobile phone. He said a sentence without raising his head, which made Lu Yangyu choke and couldn't speak. He stood there with his hands tied. Shen Yongfeng was quite affectionate and pulled him back. Doctor Ma said, "Oh, division director, don't bully the young man like this."
"The truth."
He is so handsome, has such good performance, is so rude to customers, and calls newcomers ugly when they first come up. It is inevitable that the division director will give people the impression of being arrogant. But when talking to his peers, his face turns quickly. As soon as he puts the phone on, his tone becomes normal and kind, "Dr. Ma, look at her, her left and right faces are asymmetrical, her forehead is too full, her cheek fat pad is so thick, she has a baby face at best, and a pie face at worst..."
The division director seemed to value personal space and did not get close. He took out a laser pen from the pocket of his white coat and pointed at Hu Yue's face, "Look at the skin, it's very white. Well, do you think this can compare with medical beauty? In fact, it's just because of your youth. She rarely invests in skin care products. They are full of hidden dangers. The freckles on her cheeks seem harmless at first glance. Director Liu, you are a dermatologist. Take a look at the instrument. I guarantee you will see that the skin will be covered with sunburn in five years. "
Those who came to be residents naturally had rich internship experience. The tone of the division director was not too exaggerated in terms of medical treatment. Many doctors with unique skills had this strong attitude. Several newcomers were stunned for a while after hearing this, and some subconsciously took out a small notebook to record it. Hu Yue was really embarrassed now. She wanted to continue crying. Without this atmosphere, she felt that her heart was a little too glassy, ​​but she had already made a gesture and did not continue crying. It was even more embarrassing to stand here and be called ugly: she cried just now when she was called ugly, and now she was treated as a teaching material and pointed at her. How could she cry? If you weren't crying, why were you crying just now?
This was the first time that Dr. Shi looked at Hu Yue. He glanced at her with a cold smile in his eyes, as if he could see the bottom of her heart at a glance: Isn't it too young for such a fledgling little girl to want to play tricks with him?
"Isn't she a maxillofacial repairer? If she wants to go to the repair center next door, the director should be very welcoming. You can't come to our group. Other clients come here with faith. You have to make them believe that as long as they work hard, grind the iron pestle into needles, and work hard to achieve miracles, they can become more beautiful if they have money." He said, looking at Hu Yue's face, "How can she stand next to me with a look like hers?"
What nonsense is this? Dr. Ma shook his head and laughed, "According to what you say, I don't want to do facial structure anymore?"
"Okay, okay," Director Zhang couldn't stand it anymore, "It's almost eight o'clock, everyone should go to the clinic first."
If you don't watch other people's excitement, you can't watch it in vain. Director Liu will get into trouble. However, it's almost eight o'clock now.Calling is necessary for diagnosis, and watching a theater is not as important as punching in. Everyone left with their contract workers. Dr. Ma was kind-hearted and took Hu Yue, who was crying silently, out, "The division director has always been like this, and it's not against you. He doesn't like to bring in residents, and arranges for a few to quarrel with others. It's like this - those few left later. When they get the attending treatment, they go to the Putian Department outside, otherwise they can introduce you to them right away."
She looked at Dai Shaohua and then at Hu Yue, feeling a little helpless, but still decided, "Just follow me first. It's okay. The division director doesn't want us. I wish we could have more people. Don't cry. I'm in Clinic No. 4. You go and wash your face first. You can come directly here later."
After thinking about it, I added, "Also, don't take what the division director said to heart. He is so handsome and has seen too many beauties. Of course he has high requirements for people. We are not celebrities. Isn't it enough?"
That's what he said, but he didn't deny Shi Ji's comment... He didn't directly refute such a word "ugly"...
